description: Frontend Interview Room Page and Components - The core interview experience displaying questions, capturing answers, showing evaluations, and tracking progress. Includes 6 reusable components (QuestionCard, AnswerInput, EvaluationDisplay, ProgressBar, ScoreCard, RecommendationCard). Handles the full interview loop until completion.
steps: Create frontend/src/components/interview/QuestionCard.tsx: functional component with props { questionNumber: number, category: string, questionText: string }, display badge for category (rounded bg-indigo-100 text-indigo-800), heading 'Question {questionNumber}', questionText in large readable font, wrapped in white card with border

Create frontend/src/components/interview/AnswerInput.tsx: props { value: string, onChange: (val: string) => void, onSubmit: () => void, loading: boolean, disabled: boolean }, textarea with rows=8, live character count display (min 50, max 5000), validation styling (red border if < 50 or > 5000), submit button disabled if invalid or loading, show spinner in button when loading

Create frontend/src/components/interview/ScoreCard.tsx: props { score: number }, display score as large centered number, background color based on score (green if >= 70, yellow if >= 50, red if < 50), text like '{score}/100'

Create frontend/src/components/interview/EvaluationDisplay.tsx: props { score: number, feedback: string, strengths: string[], weaknesses: string[] }, layout: ScoreCard at top, feedback section (scrollable if long), strengths list with CheckCircle2 icons in green, weaknesses list with AlertCircle icons in amber, white card with sections separated by borders

Create frontend/src/components/interview/ProgressBar.tsx: props { current: number, total: number }, display progress bar (filled portion indigo gradient), text '{current} of {total} answered' and '{Math.round(current/total*100)}%', animated transition on progress change

Create frontend/src/components/interview/RecommendationCard.tsx: props { strengths: string[], weaknesses: string[], topicsToImprove: string[], overallFeedback: string }, 4-section card: strengths (green theme with check icons), weaknesses (amber theme with alert icons), topics to improve (indigo badges), overall feedback (bordered text block)
Create frontend/src/app/interview/[id]/page.tsx: 'use client', import useParams, useState, useEffect, api, Navbar, all interview components

State: questions (array), currentQuestionIndex (number, default 0), answerText (string), answers (Map<questionId, answer>), evaluations (Map<questionId, evaluation>), showEvaluation (boolean), currentEvaluation (object), loading (boolean), submitting (boolean), interview (object), timeTakenSeconds (number)
useEffect on mount: GET /interviews/:id/questions to load questions array, GET /interviews/:id to load interview metadata, set currentQuestionIndex to first unanswered question index
Display: ProgressBar (interview.answeredQuestions, interview.totalQuestions), QuestionCard (questions[currentQuestionIndex]), AnswerInput if !showEvaluation, EvaluationDisplay if showEvaluation
AnswerInput onChange: setAnswerText, track time using Date.now() - questionStartTime for timeTakenSeconds

AnswerInput onSubmit: setSubmitting(true), POST /interviews/:id/answers with { questionId: questions[currentQuestionIndex].id, answerText, timeTakenSeconds }, response contains { answer, evaluation, nextQuestion, isCompleted }, setCurrentEvaluation(evaluation), setShowEvaluation(true), store answer and evaluation in maps, setSubmitting(false)

After evaluation shown: display 'Next Question' button (or 'Complete Interview' if isCompleted), onClick: if isCompleted POST /interviews/:id/complete then router.push(/interview/${id}/report), else setCurrentQuestionIndex++, setShowEvaluation(false), setAnswerText(''), reset timer
Loading states: show skeleton while loading questions, disable answer input during submission, show spinner on submit button
Error handling: try-catch all API calls, display error alerts, allow retry without losing state
Layout: Navbar + main container with max-w-5xl, white cards with shadows
acceptance_criteria: All 6 interview components created and properly typed
Interview room page loads questions on mount
Current question displays with category and number
Answer input enforces 50-5000 character limit with live validation
Submitting answer shows loading state and disables input
Evaluation displays immediately after submission with score, feedback, strengths, weaknesses
Progress bar updates after each answer
Next Question button advances to next unanswered question
Complete Interview button triggers completion and redirects to report
Page handles errors gracefully without losing interview state
verification: Complete interview setup to reach interview room
Type 100 characters in answer, verify character count updates
Try submitting with < 50 chars, verify button disabled
Submit valid answer, verify loading spinner appears
Verify evaluation displays with score and feedback
Answer all questions, verify 'Complete Interview' button on last question
